messages:
mike_sales: Hey product — FinEdge (prospect) resurfaced a VPC/on‑prem ask. They want Redwood Private in their staging VPC first, then air-gapped prod. Asking for a realistic timeline + list of non‑negotiable dependencies. They need HSM integration and a signed SLA. Can we triage?

jess: Thanks Mike. Can you drop the customer's basic constraints (region, expected qps, data residency)?

mike_sales: Region: eu-west-1 for staging, prod will be air‑gapped in their Frankfurt datacenter. Expected steady QPS ~50 requests/s during peak, variable seq len, mostly chat gen. Compliance: FIN regulation, needs KMS/HSM + audit logs for 7 years.

ana_eng: tagging @ana_eng — quick note: 50 qps with KV cache + batching should be fine on Dedicated, but on‑prem we'll need our runtime packaged for their GPUs + CUDA compatibility.

ana_eng: Checklist I'm thinking: 1) Network/VPN or direct connect 2) KMS/HSM cert exchange 3) Deployment bundle (container + runtime) for their OS 4) Permitted egress rules 5) Test dataset and eval prompts for regression checks

jess: Good list. Also add acceptance criteria: 1) can serve 50 qps with p95 latency < 250ms in staging 2) end‑to‑end audit log visible in Console 3) rollback plan and fallback to hosted variant for a week after launch

oliver_infra: From infra side: need at least two staging nodes (N+1) to simulate failover. We'll want SSH/console access window and an install window for drivers. For air‑gapped prod we need an offline installer + verification script.

oliver_infra: Example verification snippet we'll ask them to run:```bash
./redwood-check.sh --gpu-info && ./redwood-runtime --smoke-test
```

srini_sec: Security flags: HSM integration requires our KMS adapter and an HSM vendor support matrix. We'll need their HSM model + firmware version. Also we require signed SLA terms around key custody and an audit enclave for logs.

jess: Prioritization ask: is this enterprise intake blocking other Private work? We should decide if FinEdge goes into the next prioritized bucket (Q2 enterprise on‑prem) or staged backlog (Q3). Pros: strategic fin account. Cons: heavy infra & security lift. Thoughts?

ana_eng: Engineering estimate: baseline effort 3‑4 weeks for staging (packaging + verification + one on‑site/remote install session), 6‑8 weeks additional for air‑gapped prod + HSM hookups + compliance checks. Dependencies on them: network access, HSM details, signed NDA / legal churn.

mike_sales: Sales notes: FinEdge expects a pilot in 8 weeks and is willing to sign a 12‑month Dedicated commitment if pilot succeeds. Legal already started NDA. They're sensitive to data egress — want proof no telemetry leaves site.

jess: Decision points we need from leadership/product: 1) Approve priority bump into Q2 pilot lane? 2) Allocate one infra engineer + one runtime engineer + one security reviewer for the pilot. 3) Accept potential impact to other Private timelines.

jess: I'll draft a minimal launch criteria doc and a customer checklist. Quick first pass: Pilot acceptance = staging deployed + perf verified + audit logs hooked + HSM KMS rotation verified. If any of those fail, fallback to hosted for 30 days while we remediate.

oliver_infra: I'll prepare the offline installer artifacts and the smoke test script. Tagging @deploy‑bot to schedule a CI build for the staging bundle.

deploy-bot: CI job queued: redwood/private-runtime-build #2113. ETA ~45m. Artifacts will be uploaded to s3://redwood-artifacts/pilot/finedge/2113000000/ on success.

srini_sec: I'll send a short template for HSM integration questions we need answered (model, firmware, PKI certs, access policy).

mike_sales: Thanks all. I'll collect FinEdge answers and push NDA + HSM details. Will update this thread with their timeline and confirm pilot commitment by EOW. :thumbsup:

jess: Great — once we have their HSM model and network plan, we'll slot the pilot and confirm engineering allocation. Leaving action items: Mike collects customer details; Ana/OIiver prep staging checklist; Srini prepares HSM questionnaire; Jess prepares acceptance criteria doc.

mike_sales: Action: customer details (due in 3 business days).

jess: OK. If anyone sees anything missing from the checklist ping me. Otherwise we'll reconvene after customer info lands. :eyes:
